title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Westfield Sleep Clinic under your health plan for services provided on July 31, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Reason for denial: Prior authorization was required for the MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast and was not obtained before the service was performed. Reason code: CO-197.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $3,222.07 billed. The provider may bill you for this service.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: You or your authorized representative may file a written appeal within 180 days of the date you receive this notice. Send it to Brightmoor Benefit Solutions, Appeals Unit, PO Box 38015, Yonkers, NY 10701. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-2334.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
